name: Robo Musume to Love Love Date
original_name: ロボ娘とラブラブデート
source:
A short novel about dating a robot girlfriend. Science fiction novelist Senichi Uenuma is chosen to go on a date with a cutting-edge robot girlfriend as part of a magazine project.
He enjoys a date with his robot girlfriend Naiko, but...
Choose a date spot and experience a fun date with Naiko!

[Translated From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/31045]Freem![/url]]
translation:
一部关于与机器人女友约会的短篇小说。作为杂志项目的一部分，科幻小说家上沼仙一被选中与一位尖端机器人女友约会。
他很享受与机器人女友奈子的约会，但是……
选择约会地点，与菜子一起体验有趣的约会吧！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/31045]Freem![/url]]
